contribution: Foundational methods for empirical analysis of markets and industrial organization, specifically estimating demand and supply in differentiated-product markets and the dynamics of firm behavior
rationale: This is a prediction, not knowledge of the result. The BLP framework (Berry, Levinsohn, Pakes) is the standard tool for demand estimation, merger analysis and antitrust. It also spread widely into trade, health and environmental economics. Empirical IO has not yet been recognized by the prize, and the 2021 to 2025 awards have favored empirical methods and applied work, so I think it is overdue.
